skill.name: lark-minutes
skill.description: Retrieves basic Lark Minutes metadata, including title, cover, duration, owner, and meeting URL, from a minute token.
skill.summary: Get basic metadata and related notes links for Lark Minutes records.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, relative documentation links, and Chinese text entropy. The confirmed risk is limited to documented lark-cli commands that may access authenticated Lark Minutes metadata and related notes links. No prompt injection attempt or hidden data-exfiltration instruction was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External lark-cli execution is required for core functionality.
remediation.suggestion: Document the allowed lark-cli subcommands and require user confirmation before running commands that access meeting data.

remediation.issue: Meeting metadata and notes links can expose sensitive business information.
remediation.suggestion: Remind users to confirm the Lark workspace, token, and authorization scope before retrieving or sharing results.

remediation.issue: Relative cross-skill links and example URLs trigger static audit noise.
remediation.suggestion: Use explicit marketplace references and clearly mark URLs as examples to reduce false positive findings.

content.value_statement: Meeting links often hide the token and basic metadata users need. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to retrieve Lark Minutes details with lark-cli.
actual_capabilities: Extracts a minute_token from a Lark Minutes URL.
Shows how to inspect the minutes.minutes.get schema before API calls.
Retrieves basic metadata such as title, cover, duration, owner, and URL.
Points users to related notes products without reading full notes by default.
Documents the readonly permission scope required for minutes.get.
limitations: Requires a working lark-cli installation and valid Lark authentication.
Only covers basic Lark Minutes metadata directly.
Does not read transcripts, summaries, tasks, or chapters by default.
Cannot access minutes outside the authenticated user permissions.

use_cases.title: Check Meeting Details
use_cases.description: Retrieve the title, owner, duration, cover, and URL for a shared Lark Minutes link.

use_cases.title: Prepare Meeting Records
use_cases.description: Collect basic metadata before linking a meeting record into a project tracker or workspace page.

use_cases.title: Review Notes Availability
use_cases.description: Find related notes links for transcripts, summaries, tasks, or chapters without opening their full content first.

prompt_templates.title: Get Basic Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one meeting link.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use lark-minutes to get the title, duration, owner, cover, and URL for this Lark Minutes link: [paste link].

prompt_templates.title: Extract Token First
prompt_templates.scenario: User has a full URL with extra query parameters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the minute_token from this Lark Minutes URL, then retrieve the basic meeting metadata: [paste URL].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Meetings
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs metadata for multiple meeting records.
prompt_templates.prompt: For these Lark Minutes links, retrieve basic metadata and list which records have related notes products: [paste links].

prompt_templates.title: Validate Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that checks schema and permissions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the Lark Minutes schema, validate the required token field, retrieve metadata, and report the readonly permission scope used.

output_examples.input: A Lark Minutes URL for a weekly project meeting.
output: Owner: listed owner ID from Lark
Related notes products: available as links only

output_examples.input: A Lark Minutes link with extra URL query parameters.
output: Extracted token: final path segment before the query string
Metadata retrieved: title, cover, duration, owner, and canonical URL

output_examples.input: A request to read the AI summary for a meeting.
output: Basic metadata can be retrieved with this skill.
Transcript, summary, task, and chapter content require the related notes workflow.
The response should show links unless the user explicitly requests content access.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace and meeting link before retrieving metadata.
Inspect the API schema before constructing lark-cli parameters.
Show related notes links first when the user did not request full content.
anti_patterns: Do not guess the minute_token when the URL format is unclear.
Do not read transcripts or summaries unless the user explicitly asks.
Do not share meeting metadata with users who lack the needed authorization.

faq.question: What does this skill retrieve?
faq.answer: It retrieves basic Lark Minutes metadata such as title, cover, duration, owner, and meeting URL.

faq.question: Does it read meeting transcripts?
faq.answer: No. It points to related notes products unless the user explicitly requests content through the notes workflow.

faq.question: What input does it need?
faq.answer: It needs a minute_token or a Lark Minutes URL that contains the token in the final path segment.

faq.question: Does it require lark-cli?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill depends on lark-cli and valid Lark authentication for API access.

faq.question: Which permission scope is used?
faq.answer: The documented scope is minutes:minutes:readonly for the minutes.get method.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when lark-cli is available.
